name: Public Bank Berhad
overview: 2026年，Public Bank Berhad 的业务动态主要涉及一家全资子公司 PB Trust (L) Ltd 的解散，该子公司此前已启动成员自愿清盘。此外，公司宣布了2026年的中期股息派发，并发布了2025年年报。季度业绩显示营收同比小幅增长，净利润同比有所下降。
overview_en: In 2026, Public Bank Berhad's business developments mainly involved the dissolution of its wholly-owned subsidiary PB Trust (L) Ltd, which had commenced member's voluntary winding-up earlier. The company also announced interim dividends for 2026 and released its 2025 annual report. Quarterly results showed slight revenue growth year-on-year, while net profit declined year-on-year.

segments.name: 集团 / Group
segments.note: 今年集团层面主要涉及一家全资子公司的解散，以及股息派发和年报发布。
segments.note_en: At the group level this year, the main events were the dissolution of a wholly-owned subsidiary, dividend announcements, and the release of the annual report.

actions.title: WINDING UP / RECEIVER & MANAGER / RESTRAINING ORDER / SPECIAL ADMINISTRATOR
actions.text: 全资子公司 PB Trust (L) Ltd 于2026年1月29日解散，此前已启动成员自愿清盘。
actions.text_en: Wholly-owned subsidiary PB Trust (L) Ltd was dissolved on 29 January 2026, after having commenced member's voluntary winding-up.

model_changes.title: WINDING UP / RECEIVER & MANAGER / RESTRAINING ORDER / SPECIAL ADMINISTRATOR
model_changes.text: 通过解散 PB Trust (L) Ltd，集团退出了该子公司所从事的业务（具体业务未在公告中说明）。
model_changes.text_en: By dissolving PB Trust (L) Ltd, the group exited the business carried out by this subsidiary (the specific business is not stated in the announcement).
